reuse.why: Reuses withBankAccountLinkGuard, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount/handleSyncResponse and server-config, and folds the per-provider link and single-account download copies into shared functions that Fintegra calls.

duplication.why: Instead of adding a sixth link copy and a fourth download copy, it removes the existing ones; Fintegra adds only a thin adapter and one branch.

placement.why: Linking stays in accounts/app.ts, downloading in accounts/sync.ts, the base path in server-config.ts and the type in types/models, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: For a server-side feature it also restructures all existing providers' link and download code (with small behavioural shifts such as Akahu's notified tables and GoCardless mask handling) and touches two client files.

maintainability.why: The shared link helper and parameterised download make adding providers cheap, though the loosely typed BankSyncExternalAccount and the akahu||fintegra branch in processBankSyncDownload are small rough edges.
